classification.difficultyReason: The student reads the marked point (40,44), divides to get k=1.1, writes N=kA, and substitutes A=250. The form N=kA and the point to use are both supplied, so this is direct application of a signposted method. It is slightly easier than p15-q3, which has the same find-k step and also asks the student to solve for the input when filling the table.
